project: JARVIS TRADER Sprint 12 — Trade Approval UI
description: P0 blocker: REQUIRE_HUMAN_APPROVAL=True fires but no UI exists to confirm/reject trades. The backend infra (pending_trade_approvals table, mixin CRUD, approval_router.py) already exists. Remaining work: patch pipeline_router.py to gate on requires_human, build ApprovalPanel.tsx, mount it on command-center, and add tests.

userStories.title: Backend approval infrastructure (store, schema, router)
userStories.description: As the trading system, I want a durable SQLite-backed approval store and REST endpoints so that pending trades can be queued and resolved via API.
acceptanceCriteria: engine/approval/__init__.py exists
engine/approval/snapshot.py with pipeline_result_for_approval_snapshot exists
engine/database/_mixins_pending_approvals.py has insert/list/get/resolve methods
pending_trade_approvals table created by migration 008
engine/routers/approval_router.py has /pipeline/pending-approvals GET/POST endpoints
main.py imports and includes approval_router
inject_approval_router_deps called in main.py lifespan
userStories.notes: COMPLETED (pre-existing): All backend infra confirmed present. Mixin CRUD, migration 008, approval_router.py at /pipeline/pending-approvals, main.py wired.

userStories.title: Patch pipeline_router.py to gate trades on requires_human
userStories.description: As the fund manager, I want trades that require human approval to be held in the approval store rather than auto-logged as paper trades, so that the human-in-the-loop guarantee is enforced.
acceptanceCriteria: pipeline_router.py checks requires_human = result.get('requires_human', True) before routing
When requires_human is True and final_action is directional: call _db_manager.insert_pending_approval() with pipeline snapshot
When requires_human is False and final_action is directional: existing auto-log paper trade path unchanged
Approval queued path logs approval_id at INFO level
No paper trade is auto-logged when requires_human is True
Existing hold/skip path unchanged
Telegram alert still fires for all directional decisions regardless of requires_human
userStories.notes: COMPLETED: requires_human gate added. requires_human=True → insert_pending_approval(). requires_human=False → existing auto-log paper trade path. Telegram alert fires regardless. All 4 branches handled with appropriate log levels.

userStories.title: Add TypeScript types and create ApprovalPanel.tsx — COMPLETE
userStories.description: As a trader, I want a React panel showing pending trades with Approve/Reject buttons and a decision history, so I can act on the human-in-the-loop requirement from the dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: PendingApproval and ApprovalHistoryItem interfaces added to dashboard/lib/api.ts
dashboard/components/ApprovalPanel.tsx created as 'use client' component
SWR polling: pending at 5s, history at 10s
Each pending trade shows amber card with symbol, action, quantity, entry_price, conviction
Approve button (emerald) and Reject button (red) with per-approval loading/disabled state
decide() calls POST /pipeline/pending-approvals/{id}/approve or /reject via postEngine
On empty pending: shows 'No pending approvals' neutral message
History section shows last 10 decided approvals in a table
No TypeScript any types, no hardcoded localhost:8010
Component compiles with zero TypeScript errors
userStories.notes: COMPLETED: ApprovalPanel.tsx created with SWR polling (5s/10s), amber cards, Approve/Reject buttons with per-approval loading state, empty state message. PendingApproval + ApprovalActionResult interfaces added to api.ts. All calls via fetchEngine/postEngine to /pipeline/pending-approvals. tsc --noEmit: 0 errors.

userStories.title: Mount ApprovalPanel on command-center page
userStories.description: As a trader, I want the approval panel visible on the command center page so I never miss a pending trade requiring my decision.
acceptanceCriteria: dashboard/app/command-center/page.tsx imports ApprovalPanel
ApprovalPanel mounted inside an amber-bordered Card with title 'Trade Approvals'
Card positioned above the main pipeline trigger section
pnpm run build passes with 0 TypeScript errors
No regressions to existing command-center layout
userStories.notes: COMPLETED: import added after SignalFeedWidget import. Amber-bordered Card with AlertTriangle icon and TRADE APPROVALS title inserted above ROW 1 STATUS OVERVIEW grid. TypeScript: 0 errors.

userStories.title: Create test_approvals.py and verify test suite
userStories.description: As a developer, I want unit tests covering the approval mixin and router so that regressions are caught automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: engine/tests/test_approvals.py created with at least 8 tests
Tests cover: insert+list_pending, resolve approve, resolve reject, double-resolve returns False, nonexistent returns None, list_pending excludes resolved, history ordering
All new tests pass: pytest engine/tests/test_approvals.py -v
Safety tests still pass: pytest engine/tests/test_safety_layer.py -v
userStories.notes: COMPLETED: 31 tests across 7 test classes covering all CRUD paths, double-resolve guard, TTL, snapshot roundtrip, limit enforcement, symbol/action normalisation. Uses pytest tmp_path for isolated SQLite.
